intro: The Devil Wears Prada (TDWP), a Dayton band that formed in 2005, were among Let's Get It's earliest and most important supporters. The first list is the band owner's own account (S22), which is not yet independently documented; the second is what public sources confirm.
owner: TDWP's support was a huge part of Let's Get It's early success, together with the owner's record-label and press contacts.
Let's Get It shared a house with members of The Devil Wears Prada.
Daniel Williams (TDWP's drummer) and Chris Rubey (TDWP's guitarist) lived with Joe Gilford and Tyler Smyth when Let's Get It started.
On early tours the band shared TDWP's van and trailer.

public.text: The Devil Wears Prada formed in Dayton, Ohio, in 2005. Daniel Williams was a co-founding drummer who stayed until 2016; Chris Rubey is listed among the co-founders.
Joey Sturgis, who produced the Digital Spaces EP, also recorded TDWP's debut album, Dear Love: A Beautiful Discord.
Both bands are on the South By So What festival bill of 14 March 2009 (flyer in the band archive and Concert Archives).

Daniel Williams died on 22 May 2025 in a plane crash in San Diego, aged 39. Dave Shapiro, Let's Get It's booking agent, died in the same crash. TDWP's statement read: "No words. We owe you everything. Love you forever."
